module: Main AI traffic system in freeroam. It spawns a group of vehicles (via core_multiSpawn), inserts them into the traffic table (gameplay/traffic/vehicle objects with roles), manages a pool of active/inactive vehicles (core_vehicleActivePooling), and respawns them in front of the focus point (player or camera) on the road network. It also manages the global traffic variables (aggression, speed limit, AI mode...), a system of "reserved" vehicles for special providers (police, taxi...), state saving/restoring and visual debug. States: 'off', 'spawning', 'loading', 'on'.
usage:
gameplay_traffic.setupTraffic(10, {activeAmount = 8})
-- ...
gameplay_traffic.setTrafficVars({baseAggression = 0.6, speedLimit = 20})
for id, veh in pairs(gameplay_traffic.getTraffic()) do print(id, veh.roleName) end
notes: Default variables (getTrafficVars): spawnValue 1, spawnDirBias 0.2, activeAmount infinite, baseAggression 0.35, speedLimit -1 (disabled, in m/s), aiMode 'traffic', aiAware 'auto', aiDebug 'off', enableRespawn true, enableDynamicValues true, enableRandomEvents false.
Exported aliases: forceTeleportAll = scatterTraffic; getNumOfTraffic = getTrafficAmount; getTrafficAiVehIds = getTrafficList; getTraffic = getTrafficData.

"Reserved" model: a vehicle with reserved = providerName belongs to a provider's reserve and stays dormant (inactive, no respawn) until it is "claimed" (used) via useReservedVehicle. A claimed vehicle is protected from automatic pooling.
Only one traffic vehicle is processed per frame for respawn (index auxiliaryData.queuedVehicle). Traffic conditions sampling (network density, direction) is done every 5 s of simulated time.
The focus (setFocus) has three modes: 'camera' (default), 'vehicle' and 'custom'; with auto = true it switches depending on the player vehicle or the free camera.

The hooks onTrafficStarted and onTrafficStopped are both emitted by onUpdate (when the first AI vehicle appears or the last one disappears) and handled by this same module (M.onTrafficStarted sets the state to 'on', M.onTrafficStopped clears the tables).
An 8 s watchdog (spawnWatchdogTimeout) ends the traffic loading if no vehicle reports progress, so as not to block the waiting screen.
Modules loaded by dependency: gameplay_parking, gameplay_police, gameplay_taxi, gameplay_traffic_trafficUtils, core_vehicleActivePooling.

debugMode.desc: Visual debug mode and log (draws a line and text per vehicle in onPreRender). Modified by setDebugMode / setTrafficVars({aiDebug='traffic'}).

showMessages.desc: Allows automatic display of UI messages (true by default).

spawnTraffic.desc: Spawns a group of vehicles via core_multiSpawn.spawnGroup (name 'autoTraffic'). Sets the state to 'spawning'. Low-level public interface; setupTraffic is preferred.

amount.desc: Number of vehicles; default: settings value minus the existing vehicles (at least 1).

options.desc: mode ('traffic' by default), gap (20 m), pos, dir.

setupTraffic.desc: Prepares traffic: removes the current traffic (unless keepCurrent), determines the number of vehicles (setting or CPU if -1), builds or loads the group (level file, custom or generated group), inserts the special providers' vehicles (up to 40% of the total) and the reserves, then switches to the 'loading' state; the actual spawn then happens in onUpdate.

amount.desc: Number of vehicles; -1 or nil = automatic according to the settings (trafficAmount, trafficExtraVehicles/trafficExtraAmount).

options.desc: activeAmount, keepCurrent, vehGroup, autoAdjustAmount, autoLoadFromFile, simpleVehs, allMods, allConfigs, pos, rot.

returns.desc: true if a spawn was started, false if there is nothing to create.

setupTrafficHelper.desc: Prepares traffic and parked vehicles at the same time (parking first). The hook onTrafficOrParkingReady signals completion.

setupTrafficWaitForUi.desc: Used by the pause menu: displays the waiting icon (app:waiting) and prepares traffic; the spawn starts in onUiWaitingState.

useParked.desc: Enable parked vehicles (ignored if traffic is enabled but the trafficParkedVehicles setting is false).

setupCustomTraffic.desc: Spawns a group created with custom parameters.

toggle.desc: Enables or disables traffic in freeroam (ignored outside freeroam or if the toggleTraffic action is blocked). If turned off, runs setupTraffic; if turned on, either removes the vehicles or, with keepInMemory, deactivates them (activeAmount = 0) for instant reactivation.

keepInMemory.desc: Keep the vehicles in memory (uses RAM).

insertTraffic.desc: Inserts an existing vehicle into the traffic table (creates the traffic vehicle object, adds it to the pool, sets the AI mode, handles the 'reserved:' marking via spawnMeta). Emits onTrafficVehicleAdded.

ignoreAi.desc: Applies neither AI nor respawn (used for the player vehicle).

ignoreVehPool.desc: Do not add it to the deactivation pool.

removeTraffic.desc: Removes a vehicle from traffic: resets the role's action, shows the vehicle again, makes it playable and takes it out of the pool. Emits onTrafficVehicleRemoved.

stopAi.desc: Set the vehicle's AI to 'stop' mode.

deleteVehicles.desc: Removes all traffic vehicles (AI or marked isTraffic) from the scene and from the table.

activate.desc: Enables traffic mode and adds vehicles to the table. If vehList is not a table, takes all non-parked vehicles (compatibility).

deactivate.desc: Removes all vehicles from the traffic table.

refreshVehicles.desc: Calls onRefresh on each traffic vehicle (resets its data).

getFocus.desc: Returns the focus table {mode, pos, dirVec, speed, vehId, auto}.

setFocus.desc: Sets the focus point used to decide which vehicles stay active or get teleported (traffic and parking).

mode.desc: 'camera', 'vehicle' or 'custom'; nil = camera with automatic switching.

data.desc: vehId (vehicle mode); pos, dir, speed (custom mode); auto (boolean).

respawnVehicle.desc: Moves a vehicle to a new position and rotation (for traffic) and calls onRespawn on its traffic object. Non-strict mode: spawn.safeTeleport (slower, avoids static geometry).

strict.desc: Direct placement (setPositionRotation + autoplace) with a 180° rotation added.

forceTeleport.desc: Forcibly teleports a traffic vehicle to a safe spawn point found around pos. Ignored if enableRespawn is false or if ignoreForceTeleport is true; an unused reserve is simply made dormant.

scatterTraffic.desc: Teleports a group of vehicles away from the current location (alias forceTeleportAll).

vehIds.desc: Vehicles; default all AI traffic vehicles.

setDebugMode.desc: Enables or disables traffic debug mode (via setTrafficVars aiDebug).

getTrafficVars.desc: Returns the traffic variables table (direct reference).

setTrafficVars.desc: Modifies the traffic variables and propagates them to the vehicles (AI mode, AI parameters, spawnValue, spawnDirBias, debug, activeAmount). Switching to an aiMode other than 'traffic' sets the roles to 'empty' (restored when returning to 'traffic').

setActiveAmount.desc: Sets the maximum number of active (visible) vehicles.

getIdealSpawnAmount.desc: Computes the ideal number of vehicles to create.

amount.desc: Requested amount; nil or negative = settings (CPU if 0).

enforceLimit.desc: Subtracts the already present active non-parked vehicles (plus one for the player).

getTrafficAmount.desc: Number of AI traffic vehicles (alias getNumOfTraffic).

activeOnly.desc: Count only the active ones (bounded by activeAmount).

getTrafficList.desc: List of AI traffic vehicle identifiers (alias getTrafficAiVehIds).

getTrafficData.desc: Full traffic table: identifier -> traffic vehicle object (alias getTraffic). Also contains the player vehicle.

freezeState.desc: Stops the traffic, police and parking systems and returns their serialized data (used for example at the start of a mission).

unfreezeState.desc: Restores the systems from the freezeState data then scatters the traffic (scatterTraffic).

trackAIAllVeh.desc: Called when the player sets an AI mode for all vehicles: applies this mode as the traffic aiMode.

registerSpecialVehicleProvider.desc: Registers (or replaces) a special vehicle provider (police, taxi...). Fields read: name (required), priority, minTotalAmount, guaranteed, getDesiredCount(amount, options), buildGroup(count, options), buildReservedGroup, reserved.

ensureReservedVehicles.desc: Ensures a provider has count reserved vehicles (in fact spawns at most 4 at a time). Emits onTrafficReservedVehiclesReady when already sufficient.

returns.desc: false if nothing to do or failure, true if already ready or spawn started.

removeReservedVehicles.desc: Removes all reserved vehicles of a provider and cancels an ongoing spawn.

useReservedVehicle.desc: Brings into service up to count dormant reserves of a provider and activates them (forced into the pool). The vehicles become "claimed".

onClaim.desc: Callback (id, veh) for each vehicle taken.

returnReservedVehicle.desc: Returns in-service reserves to the dormant pool. They keep driving until their next teleport out of sight, where they deactivate; with immediate, they become dormant right away.

recycleReservedVehicle.desc: Replaces in place the model/config of an unused reserve (spawn.setVehicleObject), sets it to the 'empty' role and dormant.

spawnData.desc: {model, config}; config can be a name or a .pc path.

protectNonReservedVehicle.desc: Protects a non-reserved vehicle from automatic pooling while a provider is using it (same protections as a taken reserve).

unprotectNonReservedVehicle.desc: Removes this protection: the vehicle becomes normal traffic again.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: starts the spawn in 'loading' state, monitors the watchdog, triggers onTrafficStarted/onTrafficStopped, updates the focus, the pool and the traffic logic (one vehicle processed per frame).

onPreRender.desc: Render hook: in debug mode, draws for each active vehicle a line to the focus and a text (id, distance, speed in km/h).

onVehicleMapmgrUpdate.desc: Hook called when a vehicle's mapmgr is ready; ends the loading when all expected vehicles have reported.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook: when a traffic vehicle spawns or is replaced, reapplies its model data and its automatic role.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook: checks that the new player vehicle is in the traffic table.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Hook: handles the reset of a traffic vehicle.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: removes the destroyed vehicle from traffic and from the ongoing spawn.

onVehicleActiveChanged.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is activated/deactivated: hides a deactivated vehicle and teleports a reactivated vehicle if its position is not safe.

onVehicleGroupSpawned.desc: Hook called when a multiSpawn group is created: activates the vehicles of the 'autoTraffic' group, applies fancy license plates, handles the reserves and emits onTrafficOrParkingReady when everything is ready.

onTrafficStarted.desc: Hook: sets the state to 'on', prepares the pool and inserts the player vehicles. Emitted by onUpdate after the first AI vehicle is inserted.

onTrafficStopped.desc: Hook: deletes the pool and clears the traffic tables ('off' state).

onClientStartMission.desc: Hook: updates the passengers' visibility of simple_traffic vehicles.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook: stops traffic, clears the reserved spawns, resets variables and focus.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: updates the passengers' visibility of simple_traffic vehicles.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: updates the passengers' visibility (enableSeatOccupants setting).

onUiWaitingState.desc: Hook called when the waiting screen is displayed: runs setupTrafficHelper with the parameters prepared by setupTrafficWaitForUi.

onSerialize.desc: Serializes the traffic state (state, vehicles, variables), then stops the traffic. With despawnVehicles, also stores the vehicles' spawn data and removes them.

onDeserialized.desc: Restores the traffic state; with respawnVehicles, recreates the stored vehicles and remaps their identifiers (role, pursuit, collisions).
